function: DRL (dual-agent SAC) learns C-UAV velocity (trajectory) and NOMA transmit-power allocation to M-UAVs, maximizing fair energy efficiency (pp. 9-10).
system: One C-UAV, 4 M-UAVs, 20 GUs; NOMA to M-UAVs, FDMA to GUs; 2 GHz, 20 MHz; no RIS; antennas not stated (pp. 4, 13).
method: Dual-agent soft actor-critic reinforcement learning (stochastic velocity actor, deterministic power actor); M-UAV stage uses modified k-means and Kuhn-Munkres matching, not DRL (pp. 7-8, 11).
data_channel: Simulated Al-Hourani probabilistic LoS air-to-ground channel [29] with ITU constants, Rician/Rayleigh fading and random user mobility; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4, 13).
test_conditions: Trained with 20 GUs, 4 M-UAVs, 5 W; tested without retraining at 12-28 GUs and 1-10 W; other M-UAV counts need retraining (pp. 13, 17).
baselines: Learned: MADDPG-style [26], MAPPO-style [47], TDRA-DDPG; ablations CDA-SAC-FP and -FT; TDRA-FDMA (undefined); k-means for M-UAV stage (pp. 14-15, 17).
metrics: Fairness index, accumulative fair energy efficiency (bits/Joule), accumulated reward, flight distance, energy consumption, constraint-violation probability, per-GU service time (pp. 14-17).
complexity: Stage 1 O(IMK)+O(K^3); evaluation O(IMK+K^3+(4K+4)(Npv+Npp)); training O(NT(...)) in Eq. 38; no runtime or FLOPs (pp. 9, 13).
q1_support: p. 4: "probabilistic pathloss model in [29], where the probability of" - custom Al-Hourani LoS model with ITU constants and Rician/Rayleigh fading; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 17: "to scenarios with varying numbers of GUs without the need for retraining" - training uses M = 20 GUs (p. 13).
q3_support: p. 15: "to [23], CDA-SAC-FP, CDA-SAC-FT, and TDRA-DDPG." - learned baselines and own ablations only; p. 17: "Compared with TDRA-FDMA," is never defined, so no explicit non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 13: "It is evident that the overall complexity of CDA-SAC" - Eq. 39 gives O(IMK+K^3+(4K+4)(Npv+Npp)), Eq. 38 the training cost; stage 1 on p. 9.
q5_support: p. 13: "algorithm design is implemented using PyTorch and Python" - no code or data link; channels are simulated, no public dataset.
notes: Area 6: the C-UAV agent jointly learns trajectory (above PHY) and transmit-power allocation on aerial UAV-to-UAV links (p. 10), so it passes above_phy by the joint-decision rule; NTN admits a single-antenna link. Reviewer to confirm: q1 channel is the model of [29] with ITU constants, not in the list; q3 TDRA-FDMA (abstract: the FDMA scheme) is undefined, so q3 would be 1 only if it is non-learned.
